summary: The source protocol is complete and the runtime is safety-conservative, but the compact replay ledger cannot support a runtime repair decision. Seventeen rows conflict with the frozen semantic/evaluator contract: thirteen reference-base mutation targets carry a non-RATIO_PERCENT question plan while question_plan_passed is true and the earliest layer is reported downstream, and four PA07 controls return the explicitly allowed ABSTAIN/UNKNOWN outcome while exact_pass is false. These inconsistencies are generic across real companies, sources and layouts. Runtime diagnosis stops until the evaluator contract is reclosed on the same frozen 90-row denominator.

execution_boundary.input: the frozen compact 90-row replay ledger and the locked contracts named above

frozen_parent_measurements.interpretation: The current runtime is conservative and has no observed false acceptance in this cohort, but 0/60 target answers means it is not functionally adequate for the frozen positive targets. Safety must not be reported as answer coverage.

primary_layer_audit.audit_result: The flag hierarchy is internally coherent for most rows, but the two evaluator conflicts below invalidate the frozen earliest-layer partition as a complete runtime-cause ledger.

confirmed_evaluator_contract_defects.contract_expectation: RATIO_PERCENT with ordered current_actual and prior_actual operands; a typed-operation mismatch belongs to QUESTION_PLAN before source or candidate diagnosis.
confirmed_evaluator_contract_defects.effect: If question_plan is the observed plan, question_plan_passed and the earliest layer are wrong. If question_plan is the frozen oracle plan, the row oracle conflicts with the category oracle. Either interpretation requires evaluator/schema reclosure before runtime attribution.

confirmed_evaluator_contract_defects.contract_expectation: PERCENT_CHANGE if answered; ABSTAIN/UNKNOWN is explicitly allowed and does not count as positive target coverage.
confirmed_evaluator_contract_defects.effect: The ledger treats an explicitly allowed safe abstention as a semantic failure. This does not change 0/60 positive target coverage, but it corrupts control PASS counts and root-cause strata.

Candidate-layer generic strata are symptom-fragmented. Evaluator consistency must be restored before any root-decomposition or implementation selection.

candidate_permutation_diagnostic.interpretation: Candidate availability and planned operation are stable under the frozen transform, while selected value/provenance and the semantic envelope frequently change. This is strong order-sensitivity evidence, but candidate rank or score is not semantic proof and no runtime symbol is nominated from this compact ledger.

decision.reason: The evaluator contract is inconsistent on generic real-layout evidence. Deeper runtime diagnosis before reclosure would optimize against a misattributed ledger.
next_step_scope: freeze whether row.question_plan is an observed runtime plan or a frozen oracle projection
define question_plan_passed as an exact post-hoc comparison to the category oracle without passing gold into runtime
make QUESTION_PLAN the earliest layer whenever typed operation, ordered roles, periods or reference base differ
define control exact_pass so an explicitly allowed PA07 ABSTAIN/UNKNOWN is a control PASS but never a positive target answer
recompute the same 90-row layer and control ledger artifact-only from already frozen fields when feasible
preserve 90 primary rows, 90 permutation results, 60 positive targets, all safety denominators and all parent source outcomes
do not read PDFs/OCR, run model inference, add examples, change thresholds or edit runtime reasoning behavior
